name: Backhaul
summary: Root-by-default advice for new Backhaul system services, with host-dependent descriptor limits.

recommendations.reason: Backhaul's service example uses continuous restart behavior.
The upstream service example delays retries by three seconds.
Use the documented descriptor setting only after the usable host and manager ceiling is known.
The descriptor ceiling must support the upstream recommendation; never raise global limits automatically.
The upstream unit orders startup after network.target.

advisories.message: Keep the existing -c argument and working directory. No missing configuration argument is inserted.

New system-service proposals default to root as deployment policy. Review the selected account and root risks before approval. Explicit --run-as choices and user-scope identity are preserved; existing services keep their saved account.
Boot ordering is not continuous connectivity or application-health monitoring.
